run.name: NCL CORP Ltd.
run.title: CP-OS host session
run.summary: NCL Corporation Ltd. is a leveraged cruise credit with adequate liquidity: net debt is 5.42x last-twelve-months Adjusted EBITDA, up from 5.26x, earnings are softening and a heavy newbuild program keeps free cash flow negative. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 14,884.5 and net debt 14,633.8 at September 30, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 2,700.1 (calculated). Principal basis (15,498.0, including finance leases) gives 5.74x. Before the October 2026 refinancing; excludes operating leases of 940.3. The parent release shows 5.5x on its own perimeter; that figure is not the issuer's.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA 2,731.4 over cash paid for interest and related fees, net of capitalized interest, of 952.0 including early redemption premiums (10-K page:169). Excluding the 162.4 early redemption premium (cash flow statement) the ratio is 3.46x. Not a covenant ratio.

cash.basis: Cash. Availability printed as 1.1 billion; total stated about 1.4 billion. Excludes the October 2026 revolver upsizing and the 380.0 revolver repayment. Undrawn export-credit facilities of about 10.8 billion are restricted to ship construction and are not included.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant values, credit agreements and the outcome of the November 17, 2026 springing-maturity test are not supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is a company measure.
CP-1 main limitation: No covenant ratio values, credit agreements or instrument table at Q3 2026 are supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is a company non-GAAP measure.
